harbour.name: Harbour
harbour.mood: Warm and local. Olive and brick on cool paper, a characterful grotesque.

coast.name: Coast
coast.mood: Clean and trustworthy. White, deep navy and one hi-vis yellow.

calm.name: Calm
calm.mood: Quiet and premium. Light type at large sizes, deep teal on cool stone.

ink.name: Ink
ink.mood: Editorial and confident. Black and white, square corners, one electric blue.

forest.name: Forest
forest.mood: Grounded and natural. Deep green and bone with an amber accent, soft pill shapes.

night.name: Night
night.mood: Moody and modern. Dark all the time, warm coral accent. Bars, barbers, tattoo, late trading.

sun.name: Sun
sun.mood: Bright and playful. Hot pink on white, a wide rounded display face, big soft corners.

riso.mood: Poster print. Cream paper, navy ink, tomato red, a big serif cut up across lines, print grain.

paddy.name: Paddy
paddy.mood: Restaurant. Cream and rice-paddy green, soft pink, a fine serif with an italic second line.

orchid.name: Orchid
orchid.mood: Restaurant. Blush and plum, bright pink, a soft chunky serif wordmark with tall condensed capitals.

ember.mood: Fine dining. Near-black and candle gold, a fine serif, thin gold rules, quiet and expensive.

umami.name: Umami
umami.mood: Black, rice-paper white and one red sun. Very wide heavy capitals, clean lines, nothing extra.

blush.name: Blush
blush.mood: Beauty editorial. Powder pink and deep rose, a high-contrast serif with italic words, arched photos.

sage.name: Sage
sage.mood: Apothecary calm. Sage green, stone and oat, a large soft serif set in lower case, square photos, lots of air.

iron.name: Iron
iron.mood: Gym floor. Black, acid lime, heavy italic condensed capitals, diagonal hazard stripes.

pomade.name: Pomade
pomade.mood: Old-school barbershop. Oxblood, cream and brass, a heavy slab serif, a striped pole.

mint.name: Mint
mint.mood: Friendly clinic. Clean white, fresh mint and deep navy, a round soft sans, blob shapes.

garage.name: Garage
garage.mood: Workshop. Hazard yellow and black, stencil capitals, hazard-tape strips, steel grey.

terrace.name: Terrace
terrace.mood: Property. Warm white, deep navy and brass, a classical serif in spaced capitals, fine frames.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.mood: Accounting. Ledger paper with ruled lines, bottle green ink, a sturdy serif and monospaced figures.

veil.name: Veil
veil.mood: Weddings. Ivory and warm taupe, a tall elegant display face with script flourishes, soft and airy.

chalk.name: Chalk
chalk.mood: Tutoring. Blackboard green, chalk white and a yellow highlighter, handwritten notes beside a clean sans.

crayon.name: Crayon
crayon.mood: Early learning. Warm cream with sunny yellow, sky blue and coral, a round bubbly face, wavy edges.

paws.name: Paws
paws.mood: Vet clinic. Calm teal and warm sand, a friendly geometric sans, rounded cards and a paw-print trail.

fresh.name: Fresh
fresh.mood: Cleaning. Bright white, clean electric blue and a splash of lemon, bold rounded sans, soap-bubble circles.

cellar.name: Cellar
cellar.mood: Cellar door. Burgundy and parchment, classical inscribed capitals and an old-style serif, quiet gold rules.

haven.name: Haven
haven.mood: Warm interiors. Sun-washed cream, rust italics, a refined serif, spaced capitals and thin lines.

nocturne.name: Nocturne
nocturne.mood: After-dark beauty. Near-black with violet and electric blue glows, a high-contrast serif with one word in violet.

basalt.mood: Stone and water. Warm grey, a light classical serif, one word glowing red, an arched photo and a deep red band.
